one_liner: Frontend cloud platform for deploying and hosting web apps, with a REST API for projects, deployments, and domains.

auth.evidence_quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
auth.notes: Vercel REST API is documented as using an 'Access Token' (bearer_token, not called an API key) for direct use, and Vercel Integrations use OAuth2 for third-party apps acting on other users' accounts. Evidence quote for the auth header format itself wasn't captured verbatim this pass; lowering confidence accordingly.

access.evidence_quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
access.notes: Vercel has a free Hobby tier with API access; Integrations marketplace listing requires review but that's a listing gate, not a call-time gate. Not independently verified with a quoted sentence this pass.

api.evidence_quote: access-groups | GET | /v1/access-groups/{idOrName} | Reads an access group
api.notes: REST API reference page lists many resource categories (access-groups, deployments, projects, domains, etc.) each with multiple endpoints, consistent with 'broad' (>100). Official hosted MCP server confirmed live at mcp.vercel.com.

verdict.rationale: Free-tier account, token-based REST API, and an official MCP server support immediate integration.
